APIKeyIdentity.description: Authoritative current-record ownership and readiness. Public IDs only. recurringAllowed requires a verified active owner and, for agent-issued keys, server-confirmed installation. It is a point-in-time check, not an authorization token or permission to reuse cached data after revocation.

AgentCredentials.description: Sensitive ordinary API-key credentials. Never log or put in browser URLs. Proofs are returned on temporary registration; handoff returns the owned candidate key.

agentRegistrationProof.description: Persist a cryptographically random 32-byte base64url proof and exact request BEFORE sending; recover only with the same proof and body. Not an OAuth token.

agentSetupCredential.description: Temporary setup credential for status and claim creation only. Not a data API key.

agentHandoffProof.description: Proof used to recover the owner key and acknowledge installation. Never sent to a data query.

agentIdentityKey.description: Ordinary FlashData API key in Authorization Bearer, only on agent identity. Data queries use X-API-Key instead.
